2.name: The Chase

effects.text: Discard 6 friendly cards to mark 1 green {mark} from left to right.

2.text: {activated} Discard 6 friendly cards to mark 1 green {mark} from left to right. {triggeredForced} End of Turn: Mark 1 red {mark}.
2.helpText: You need to chase him down! Discard 6 friendly cards to mark 1X on the green track. Since this is an activated effect, this card is discarded when you do, so that you don't have to perform the end of turn effect, where you must otherwise mark 1X on the red track. If the red track is completed, you lose this card forever.
